task: Independent security review of the inference identity/session database follow-up
scope: The session_entries schema, forward migration 0004, generated migration metadata, migration and schema tests, the SessionEntryWriter, the agent-sdk in-memory resume cache, connection resolution, and the chat host-to-funder path. No implementation, test, migration, ledger, or lifecycle file was changed.
summary: Commit 92e229b1 closes the legacy nullable-connection state without inventing ownership. The migration deletes only session_entries rows whose connection_id is NULL, copies bound rows unchanged, makes connection_id NOT NULL, and preserves the chat and connection ON DELETE CASCADE foreign keys, global sdk_session_id uniqueness, per-chat (chat_id, seq) uniqueness, the connection lookup index, and the partial one-primary-per-(chat, connection) index. Production session resume and persistence update paths are connection-scoped, and the resolved connection is owner-checked against the frozen room host principal before the agent-sdk backend runs.

legacyNullDisposition.evidence: packages/db/src/migrations/0004_require_session_entry_connection.sql:16 copies only rows WHERE connection_id IS NOT NULL. There is no UPDATE, owner lookup, fallback, or guessed assignment in the migration.

notNull.evidence: packages/db/src/migrations/0004_require_session_entry_connection.sql:10 declares connection_id text NOT NULL; packages/db/src/schema/sdk-session.ts:70-73 applies .notNull() before the user_connections reference.

foreignKeys.evidence: packages/db/src/migrations/0004_require_session_entry_connection.sql:12-13 recreates chat_id -> chats.id ON DELETE CASCADE and connection_id -> user_connections.id ON DELETE CASCADE. The 0004 snapshot contains both cascades.

indexes.evidence: packages/db/src/migrations/0004_require_session_entry_connection.sql:20-23 recreates session_entries_chat_seq_unique on (chat_id, seq), session_entries_sdk_session_unique on sdk_session_id, the partial session_entries_primary_unique on (chat_id, connection_id) WHERE is_primary = 1, and session_entries_connection_idx on connection_id.

snapshotChain.evidence: 0004_snapshot.json is valid JSON, contains 104 tables, points to 0003's snapshot id, and after normalizing snapshot ids and connection_id.notNull it is byte-semantically equal to 0003. No unrelated schema drift is encoded. meta/_journal.json appends 0004 at index 4.

migrationRunner.evidence: packages/db/src/client/index.ts:388-414 disables foreign key enforcement at connection scope before Drizzle's transaction, restores it through AsyncDisposable on every exit, and the migration test runs assertReferentialIntegrity after applying 0004.

securityTrace.principalToConnection: packages/server/src/entry/compose/chat.ts:997-1007 resolves chat work from funderUserId using the frozen host's real Principal. packages/inference/src/resolve/resolve-task.ts:144-169 derives funder from principal.userId and refuses a connection whose ownerId differs before any backend execution.
securityTrace.resumeIsolation: packages/inference/src/backends/agent-sdk/session/store.ts:173-290 keys recorded/resolved sessions by chatId plus connectionId, includes connectionId in deterministic session-id derivation, and carries connectionId into persistence inserts and updates. packages/inference/src/backends/agent-sdk/runner.ts:248-260 passes the resolved connection id on seeded and unseeded resume paths.
securityTrace.updateIsolation: packages/server/src/entry/compose/session-entries.ts:49-57 updates only where both sdk_session_id and connection_id match, requires exactly one returned row, and otherwise throws. The SDK handle remains globally unique, so the predicate cannot update multiple rows.
securityTrace.writerCensus: A structural scan over 2,636 TypeScript files under packages found one production session_entries insert and one production update, both in packages/server/src/entry/compose/session-entries.ts; no production delete exists. A literal sweep of packages/inference/src, packages/server/src, and packages/db/src corroborated that the only other production session_entries reads are observability counts. Those source trees contain zero TSX files, so the TypeScript structural scan covered their complete typed production surface.
securityTrace.conclusion: No cross-principal resume or update path remains in the reviewed production graph. Connection ids are not caller-supplied at the session seam: they come from a connection already resolved and owner-checked for the frozen room host.

behavioralProof.migration: tests/db/client.int.test.ts applies migrations 0000-0003 to an isolated :memory: database, inserts one bound and one NULL legacy session row, applies 0004, proves only the bound row survives, reads PRAGMA table_info to prove NOT NULL, proves a new NULL insert is rejected, and proves deleting the connection cascades the surviving row.
behavioralProof.schema: tests/db/schema/sdk-session.int.test.ts proves NULL refusal, valid round-trip, missing-chat FK refusal, chat cascade, connection cascade limited to that lineage, per-chat sequence uniqueness, global SDK-session uniqueness, and independent primaries per connection with duplicate-primary refusal.
behavioralProof.resume: tests/inference/backends/agent-sdk/session-store.test.ts proves a session recorded for one connection is not resolved through a second connection for the same chat.
behavioralProof.update: tests/server/entry/compose/session-entries.int.test.ts proves a foreign connection cannot rewrite another connection's SDK session and that the original row is unchanged; it also proves independent primaries for two connections in one chat.

verification.result: PASS: the five-migration chain through 0004 accounts for the live schema model

verification.command: pnpm typecheck --config packages/db/tsconfig.json --config packages/inference/tsconfig.json --config packages/server/tsconfig.json --config tsconfig.json

securityAssumptions: UserConnectionId values identify globally unique user_connections rows and the connection resolver remains the only production route into an agent-sdk ChatRequest.
The room host identity used as funderUserId remains frozen by the chat turn-identity path before connection resolution.
session_entries remains backend-internal optimization and observability state; there is no user-facing reader that accepts an SDK session handle or connection id to resume a row directly.
Foreign key enforcement remains enabled outside the migration runner's scoped rebuild window and boot continues to call assertReferentialIntegrity after migration.
limitations: No live or shared database was opened. Migration behavior was exercised only against isolated libSQL :memory: databases built from the committed 0000-0004 chain.

The review did not run the full pnpm check or pnpm verify --push batteries; it ran the focused behavioral suites, affected native typecheck programs, Drizzle chain check, and DB baseline parity check.

No concurrent-insert stress test was run. The unique indexes fail closed on competing per-chat sequence or primary inserts, while session persistence is explicitly best-effort; concurrency throughput is outside this security verdict.
repositoryMutation: Only this requested review artifact was added. Test runners produced ignored report artifacts. An unrelated pre-existing untracked world-tools-inference-boundaries-security-review.json was preserved untouched.
